articles.title: Everything you need to know from the US midterm elections

events.summary: Democrats achieved major victories and several historic firsts in the U.S. midterm elections. President Trump formally congratulated the party on its gains.
events.why: U.S. midterm outcomes alter the balance of legislative power and set the federal policy agenda.

articles.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing

events.summary: Kyiv reported that at least 40 people were killed and roughly 30 more may remain under rubble after a Russian double-tap bombing on a Ukrainian village. Officials stated that bodycam video documents the deadly attack.
events.why: Targeted double-tap strikes causing mass civilian casualties highlight severe violations of international humanitarian law and escalate wartime destruction.

articles.title: Typhoons batter East Asia as El Niño makes Pacific 'burn with fever'

events.summary: East Asia is experiencing unusually severe weather as typhoons batter the region, driven by El Niño conditions heating the Pacific. The extreme weather has persisted over recent months.
events.why: Unusually severe climate and weather events in East Asia threaten millions of livelihoods, infrastructure, and regional economic stability.

articles.title: What Democrats can and can't do with their new power after taking Congress

events.summary: Following midterm elections, Democrats hold power to pass legislation through Congress. However, President Trump retains executive veto power.
events.why: A split government directly shapes the trajectory of national legislation, federal budgets, and statutory oversight in the United States.

articles.title: Secret police files released in Hungary, 37 years after fall of communism

events.summary: Hungary released communist-era secret police files 37 years after the regime's collapse. Critics argue the release is incomplete, long overdue, and risks creating domestic division.
events.why: The public disclosure of historical surveillance archives affects transitional justice, national accountability, and public trust in state institutions.

articles.title: Has India’s democracy failed its Muslims? Jailed scholar triggers debate

events.summary: An interview with jailed scholar Sharjeel Imam triggered national debate after he challenged foundational ideas of Indian nationalism. The discussion centers on the treatment and representation of Muslims in Indian democracy.
events.why: Contestation over minority rights and constitutional foundations directly affects civil liberties and political polarization in India.

articles.title: The young politicians with African roots making history in the US midterms

events.summary: Young politicians of African descent secured historic victories in the U.S. midterms. The wins are inspiring political engagement among youth in African countries.
events.why: Diaspora electoral breakthroughs influence transnational political mobilization and cross-border civic engagement.
